sentences.en: It was Saturday, but it was raining all morning.
sentences.pt: Era sábado, mas estava chovendo a manhã inteira.

sentences.en: Tom wanted to go to the park with his dog.
sentences.pt: Tom queria ir ao parque com o cachorro dele.

sentences.en: Instead, he stayed at home and cleaned his room.
sentences.pt: Em vez disso, ele ficou em casa e arrumou o quarto.

sentences.en: He found an old book under his bed.
sentences.pt: Ele encontrou um livro velho embaixo da cama.

sentences.en: He read it for two hours, and the dog slept next to him.
sentences.pt: Ele leu por duas horas, e o cachorro dormiu ao lado dele.

sentences.en: In the afternoon, the rain stopped, so they finally went out.
sentences.pt: À tarde, a chuva parou, então eles finalmente saíram.
